items.quote:
Kindly transfer the total within 21 days of the date of this invoice, quoting the invoice
number.
items.computation: Invoice date is 21 November 2026. This is a private commercial invoice, so §§ 187, 193 BGB apply. Under §187(1) BGB, since the period runs 'within 21 days of' the stated date, that day itself is not counted; the period starts the next day, 22 November 2026. Counting 21 days from 22 November 2026: 22-30 Nov = 9 days, leaving 12 more days in December, landing on 12 December 2026 as day 21. 12 December 2026 is a Saturday. Under §193 BGB, when the last day of a period is a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, the period ends on the next business day. The next day, 13 December 2026, is a Sunday, so the deadline moves to Monday, 14 December 2026 (no NW public holiday falls in between).
